name: eager_trufflesnout_trample_damage_makes_a_food
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Trample. Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, create a Food token.' Eager Trufflesnout (4/2) attacks and Opp Bear (2/2) blocks: 2 to the Bear, the excess 2 tramples over to seat 1, so the trigger makes one Food. Seat 0 then pays {2}, {T} and sacrifices the Food: it gains 3 life and the Food is gone.
